_comment: TEMPLATE. A file-backed store using the same path shape as Vault, for the
one case where it is legitimate: an application whose credentials are
genuinely public, such as a public demo site. Anything else belongs in
LocalSecretStore serves only the selecting profile's own credential root,
so entries for one target can never be read by another.
Path shape matches Vault KV v2: <root>/<accountType>/<role>/<n>.
